dedupe_keys.name: hydrocrowd paper b artifacts command limiting versus immobilisation in flood aware crowd evacuation models

description: Hamzah Asyrani Sulaiman and colleagues publish HydroCrowd Paper B artifacts for comparing failure mechanisms in flood-aware crowd evacuation. Zenodo archives version 2.0.0 under Apache 2.0. The description distinguishes a sealed preregistered sweep, scenario specifications, seeds, generators and run logs from later exploratory sensitivity analyses. The two mechanisms are command limitation and physical immobilisation, with separate table and figure sources. These materials can benchmark evacuation-model behaviour when flood water interferes with decisions or movement. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this controlled comparison. Coverage is the study’s designed scenarios, not observed people in a real flood. A limitation is that the page describes an artifact bundle, not a general-purpose simulation interface, and some version 2 analyses are post-review exploration, not preregistered results. The archive was not downloaded, no gate script was executed and numerical results were not reproduced.
